messages:
Grace: quick follow-up re: low-bit rollout economics. I want an ops-friendly fallback taxonomy + cost-impact fields so SRE/finance can reason about tradeoffs without digging into raw logs.

Hector: agreed. Minimal fields: action, est_cost_delta_percent, est_latency_delta_ms, est_quality_delta_score. Keep them conservative (upper-bound cost savings).

Imani: for quality delta we should return a normalized metric + confidence band, e.g., -0.03 (+/-0.01). runtime can choose to ignore low-confidence suggestions.

Jonah: runtime impl note: we prefer stateless decisions for hot paths. If control plane returns a decision with ttl, runtime can cache it keyed by deploy-tag + context-hash. No per-request roundtrip for every token.

Keisha: define deploy-tag = model:version|quant:profile|kernel:hash. Also include profile_staleness boolean. If staleness=true, prefer conservative baselines and emit metric `quant_stale_count`.

Grace: concrete JSON decision example?

Hector:```json
{
  "action": "force_int8",
  "est_cost_delta_percent": "-22",
  "est_latency_delta_ms": "+8",
  "est_quality_delta_score": "-0.025",
  "confidence": "0.82",
  "ttl_s": "300",
  "reason": "high_surprisal_bucket",
  "tags": ["canary-3%","shadow=false"]
}
```

Imani: add `hysteresis_hint` field like `min_hold_s` and `cooldown_s` so runtime doesn't flip-flop around thresholds.

Jonah: also want `rollback_scope`: `tenant-only` vs `global`. For dedicated customers we may prefer tenant-only adjustments.

Keisha: telemetry: runtime should emit `decision_applied:true|false`, `decision_source:control|local`, `decision_hash`, `deploy_tag`, and the raw signals that triggered it (surprisal_mean, token_count, embedding_delta). Keep the raw signal names stable across runtime versions.

Grace: sampling: baseline telemetry at 100% minimal signals (deploy_tag, decision_hash, applied), detailed signals at 1% and full payload at 0.1% for storage control. Ops can bump during incidents.

Hector: ops cost table sketch (rows): action, compute_delta, storage_delta, expected_quality_impact, recommended_canary_pct. We'll keep recommended canary default = 1% for force-4bit, 3% for fp8, 0.5% for experimental kernels.

Imani: canary metadata should include `allowed_actions` list so runtime can't apply out-of-band degradations. e.g., allowed_actions=["shadow_log_only","force_int8"].

Jonah: for runtime-local fallback heuristics proposal: 1) short-circuit on token-budget breach, 2) on per-request surprisal > threshold, 3) on kv-cache-miss storm. Local decisions logged but control-mode overrides if present.

Keisha: add ops-bot integration: when canary launches include `canary-policy` JSON blob and `shadow-only` flag. Ops-bot should post the rollout and the policy link.

ops-bot: Canary: quant-profile "vfp8-2026-02" started in eu-central-1 with policy https://console.redwood/canaries/1799995555 at 2026-02-11T09:23:17Z :white_check_mark:

Grace: next steps: Hector to draft the decision schema (incl hysteresis fields), Imani to propose sampling rates and confidence formatting, Jonah to write the runtime caching rules. We'll circle up 30m tomorrow. @Keisha can you produce the initial ops cost-table?
